case_title.quote: NAGJI ODHA VJI KUMBHAR & ANR. v. STATE OF GUJARAT

number_of_accused.reason: Two appellants (appellant nos. 1 and 2) are before the Court.

accused_gender.reason: Gender of the appellants is never expressly stated; Male is inferred from names.

victim_gender.quote: causing death of Bhura Govind and Lakha Arjan
victim_gender.reason: Victims are referred to as 'both of them' and by male names; the judgment's other references give male victims, so 'Not stated' is likely wrong.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: The cause of occurrence is that the appellants were not giving right of way to the deceased.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Right-of-way/land dispute and civil injunction are stated.

weapon.quote: The appellants were having spear, Hansraj was having axe and others were having sticks.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: The deceased had multiple stab wounds on the chest.

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted for life for offence under Section 302 but no separate punishment was inflicted for the offence under Section 324

high_court_outcome.correct_value: High Court maintained conviction under ss. 302 and 324 (order dated 24.10.2008)
high_court_outcome.quote: order passed by the High Court of Gujarat ... on 24.10.2008 maintaining conviction
high_court_outcome.reason: Maintained conviction is stated; 'dismissed' appeal is an inference but reasonable.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove the references to arrest and the 'first account' of the accused as being from a cross-complaint, and avoid implying the finding that the victims were unarmed.
neutral_facts.quote: The first version of the appellants is that the deceased were not armed.
neutral_facts.reason: Largely accurate, but it includes some adjudicative material and 'men' gendering; 'stabbed... and struck' is slightly beyond the evidence.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment does not state the punishment under s.302 (only mentions 10 years under s.304 Part II).

premeditation_planning.quote: it cannot be said that the appellants have acted at the spur of the moment without pre-meditation

motive.quote: the appellants were not giving right of way to the deceased

key_evidence_accepted.quote: The Post-Mortem report corroborates an oral testimony

witness_credibility.correct_value: Presence of PW-3 and PW-4 not seriously disputed; their testimony of armed appellants relied upon; IO's argument rejected as not meriting consideration.
witness_credibility.quote: the presence of the two witnesses at the time of occurrence is not seriously disputed
witness_credibility.reason: 'Accepted as reliable' is slightly beyond the text, though relied on.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Nothing about conduct beyond hospitalisation and arrest.

custody_duration.quote: The appellants have undergone more than 11 years of actual imprisonment

legal_representation.quote: Ravi Prakash Mehrotra, Ankit Agarwal, Ms. Deepti R. Mehrotra, Advs.

investigation_status.quote: The FIR was lodged at 7 AM on 2nd July 1987 and the appellants were arrested on 17th July 1987.

prosecution_argument.reason: No separate State submissions are recorded.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Jangir Singh v. State of Punjab 2018 (15) SCALE 88 – distinguished

judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: multiple injuries on the vital parts of the deceased
